title: Connection Component
description: Describes a REST API connection — how to talk to a system and fetch or push data.

id.description: Unique identifier for this connection component.

short_description.description: Human-readable summary of what this connection does.

purpose.description: Whether this connection reads data, writes data, or both.

body.description: Request body. May be an object or a {{placeholder}}.

validation.description: Path to a JSON Schema file to validate the response against.

filter.description: A {{fn:call}} that returns true to keep the response, false to discard it.

output.description: A {{fn:call}} or {{placeholder}} describing where to store the response.

resolver.description: Relative path to the Node.js resolver module for this connection.
